newsitem.title: INDIA: Gunmen kill three Indian security personnel.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill three Indian security personnel.

text.p: Suspected militants killed three Indian army personnel and a civilian in the northeastern state of Manipur on Friday, local news agencies said.
The Press Trust of India, quoting official sources, said up to 30 gunmen fired on the vehicle the security party were travelling in.
The attack took place in the state's Bishenpur district.
Dozens of militant groups in northeastern India are fighting for independent homelands.
